newsitem.title: USA: Joseph Wilson named to key Africa post.
newsitem.headline: Joseph Wilson named to key Africa post.

text.p: A veteran U.S. diplomat, Joseph Wilson, was appointed on Thursday as senior director of African affairs at the White House National Security Council.
As deputy chief of the U.S. mission in Baghdad in 1990, Wilson negotiated the release of several hundred American hostages held by the Iraqi government in the runup to the Gulf War.

Wilson was political adviser to the commander-in-chief of U.S. armed forces in Europe from 1995 to 1997. He was U.S. ambassador to Gabon and also served in postings in Burundi, Congo, Niger, Togo and South Africa.
